steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each variance is placed by whether it is explained and whether a budget exists.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Material variance with no explanation
findings.fix: Explain the variance or correct the forecast

findings.title: Explanation does not match the variance size
findings.fix: Rewrite the explanation to the figures

outcome.notChecked: The true cause of each variance.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] var-overtime.csv:12  Material variance with no explanation.
       Fix: Explain the variance or correct the forecast.
[medium] var-supplies.csv:19  Explanation does not match the variance size.
       Fix: Rewrite the explanation to the figures.
[low] var-contract.csv:26  Actuals with no budget line.
       Fix: Add the budget line.
Not checked: The true cause of each variance.
pros: Checks a material variance with no explanation, a line with actuals and no budget, and an explanation that does not match the variance size.
cons: Not checked: The true cause of each variance.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-budget-variance skill on the records for this review.
